answer: The nebula schedule is applied in nectar and whisper shows each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3282 identities would post 2840 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
